ISH Primary School basketball

An hour of basketball every Friday for children at ISH, the International School of Hellerup. We collect your child from school and bring them back afterwards.

When
Fridays 15:30 to 16:30
Where
Ryparkens idrætsanlæg
Pickup
Our coaches collect from school and bring them back
Price
1,800 DKK per half season
Sign up

Fun first

Our coaches learn every child's name, cheer them on and keep the energy up with playful drills and small competitions. The kids want to come back the next week.

Sessions are planned so first-timers and kids who already play are both challenged at the right level. Everyone grows at their own pace, and trying, and missing, is part of the fun.

The afternoon

Your child's basketball coach handles the whole afternoon.

15:00
Coach collects your child from school
15:30
An hour of basketball at Ryparkens idrætsanlæg. Games, drills and a lot of laughing
16:30
Training finishes
17:00
Coach drops your child back at school, ready for normal pickup
